description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveRequestDao class, which manages database operations related to leave requests within a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and updating leave requests, leaves, and associated entitlements, as well as handling leave status changes and overlap checks.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDao
classes.description: This class provides methods for performing CRUD operations and complex queries related to leave requests, leaves, entitlements, and their statuses within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists a leave request along with associated leave entries and entitlement adjustments within a transaction.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Saves a leave request comment, setting the created timestamp if necessary.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Persists a leave entity.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave and optionally adjusts entitlements and linked leave records within a transaction.

methods.name: getOverlappingLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leave records that overlap with a specified date range and times for a particular employee.

methods.name: getTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Calculates total leave hours for an employee on a specific date, considering only non-cancelled/rejected leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Fetches a leave entity by its ID.

methods.name: markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Triggers the internal method to update leave statuses from approved to taken if applicable.

methods.name: _markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Private method that updates all approved leaves older than the current date to 'taken' status, only once per execution.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests for a given employee within an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeavesByEmpNumberAndDates
methods.description: Fetches leave records for an employee on specific dates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequests
methods.description: Returns a list of leave requests based on search filters, ensuring leave statuses are up-to-date.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave requests matching the search filters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for iterating over leave requests based on filters.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns leave records based on search filters, after updating leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leaves matching the search filters.

methods.name: getLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator for leave records based on filters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a leave request by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns leaves associated with a specific leave request ID.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all leave status records.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Fetches leaves for multiple leave request IDs.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveIds
methods.description: Fetches leave records by their IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaves
methods.description: Returns leaves for an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for employee leaves based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesCount
methods.description: Counts employee leaves matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Returns distinct leave type IDs used by an employee within an optional date range.
